ckpt_name.tooltip: The YuE2 checkpoint in models/checkpoints: yue2_3b_int8_convrot (default, for 8-16 GB GPUs) or yue2_3b_bf16 (24 GB and more). ComfyUI offers the download when the file is missing.

0.tooltip: YuE2 for the render (through the instrumental adapter, bypassed unless switched on).

1.tooltip: YuE2's language side: planning, rendering, token counts.

3.tooltip: The music model's rules and exact tokenizer, for Write Song and the Song Sheets.

brief.tooltip: The Song Brief or Cover Brief: what to write (and its creativity: the draft's temperature).

engine.tooltip: From the music model block: the rules the writing follows.

score.tooltip: The final score (covers): the lyrics follow its sections, and new cover lyrics are fitted to its phrases line by line.

language.tooltip: The language Transcribe Lyrics heard (an original-lyrics cover whose brief says auto).

reference_lyrics.tooltip: The source's transcribed lyrics (new cover lyrics with the phrasing reference or a lyrics closeness above 0); requested only then.

model.tooltip: The writer: a text model of ComfyUI (a bare file name, written by Generate Text; Gemma 4 E4B by default) or a Local LLM model (GGUF files, LM Studio, Ollama ...). Only the chosen one is loaded; the templates link it to the Writer model node. Press R to refresh the list.

sampling_mode_seed.tooltip: The draft seed: the same seed and brief give the same draft; another seed, another draft. The brief's song seed is added, so every song of a series gets its own.

song_seed.tooltip: From the brief: a new value for every song of a series, 0 for one song (added to the draft seed).

thinking.tooltip: Let a reasoning writer think before it answers (Qwen, Gemma ...): slower, the thoughts are not used. Needs more tokens.

1.tooltip: The style draft (MiniMax Music 3: the caption).

2.tooltip: The lyrics draft (new cover lyrics: fitted to the melody).

4.tooltip: What Parse Song Draft read and enforced.

5.tooltip: How the lyrics fit the melody (new cover lyrics; Fit Lyrics).

score.tooltip: The score to arrange: YuE2's plan, or a cover's transcription.

brief.tooltip: The brief: the creative mode and its closeness (arrangement off: nothing runs here), and its creativity (the plan's temperature).

engine.tooltip: The music model: YuE2's context budget is checked with it.

style.tooltip: The song's style: the mood, and the exact context budget.

lyrics.tooltip: The song's lyrics: the mood, and the exact context budget.

model.tooltip: The writer: a text model of ComfyUI (a bare file name, written by Generate Text; Gemma 4 E4B by default) or a Local LLM model (GGUF files, LM Studio, Ollama ...). Only the chosen one is loaded; the templates link it to the Writer model node. Press R to refresh the list.

seed.tooltip: Another seed, another arrangement of the same song (the writer's plan and the notes Plenio writes). The brief's song seed is added.

song_seed.tooltip: From the brief: a new value for every song of a series, 0 for one song (added to the arrangement seed).

0.tooltip: The arranged score, or the score as it was (the report says why).

1.tooltip: What was arranged and kept, for Song Sheet · Score.

lyrics.tooltip: The lyrics draft Transcribe Lyrics made from the source's singing.

report.tooltip: Transcribe Lyrics' report: which words it heard unsure.

brief.tooltip: The Cover Brief: only original lyrics are checked.

model.tooltip: The writer: a text model of ComfyUI (a bare file name, written by Generate Text; Gemma 4 E4B by default) or a Local LLM model (GGUF files, LM Studio, Ollama ...). Only the chosen one is loaded; the templates link it to the Writer model node. Press R to refresh the list.

0.tooltip: The draft, with the misheard words corrected.

1.tooltip: What was corrected, and why not the rest.

style.tooltip: The final style (Song Sheet · Text): what YuE2 plans for.

lyrics.tooltip: What the planner reads (Song Sheet · Text's plan_lyrics): the lyrics, or a section form for an instrumental.

seed.tooltip: The plan seed: the same seed gives the same plan; another seed, another melody and form. The brief's song seed is added.

song_seed.tooltip: From the brief: added to the plan seed, so every song of a series gets its own plan.

switch.tooltip: On: YuE2 plans a score (melody, chords, form) that the Song Sheet shows and you can edit. Off: no score - YuE2 renders without a plan.

mode.tooltip: full: melody and chords; melody: the melody only (YuE2 harmonises it when it renders).

creativity.tooltip: From the brief: 0 steady, 50 the reference (the native defaults), 100 experimental (the default), 200 adventurous - the sampling of this block follows it. Here: the plan's temperature, top-p and top-k (how freely YuE2 picks notes, chords and rhythms).

0.tooltip: The planned score in the lyrics' song form (empty with planning off).

1.tooltip: How the plan was made to fit the lyrics' song form (for Song Sheet · Score).

style.tooltip: The final style (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

lyrics.tooltip: The final lyrics (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

abc.tooltip: The final score (Song Sheet); empty: YuE2 renders without a score.

mode.tooltip: From the Song Sheet: full when the score has chords, melody otherwise.

seed.tooltip: The take seed: another seed, another take of the same documents. It drives both the token and the audio sampling.

max_duration.tooltip: The longest the take may run (the Song Sheet derives it from the score's length); YuE2 may end earlier.

creativity.tooltip: From the brief: 0 steady, 50 the reference (the native defaults), 100 experimental (the default), 200 adventurous - the sampling of this block follows it. Here: the take's temperature, top-p and top-k (how freely YuE2 performs the score).

2.tooltip: The second take (seed + 1): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity high or highest, when the first take sang less than 96 % of the lyrics).

3.tooltip: The third take (seed + 2): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity highest, when neither take sang 96 % of the lyrics).

audio.tooltip: The source recording (trim it first for a part of the song).

0.tooltip: The transcribed score (native two-voice ABC, chords).

1.tooltip: Bar times and sung notes of the source, for the lyrics and the editor.

2.tooltip: Bars, tempo, key, sections and voices.

3.tooltip: The loaded SheetSage2, for Check Vocals.

style.tooltip: The final style (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

lyrics.tooltip: The final lyrics (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

abc.tooltip: The final score (Song Sheet); empty: YuE2 renders without a score.

mode.tooltip: From the Song Sheet: full when the score has chords, melody otherwise.

seed.tooltip: The first take's seed; the next takes use the following seeds. Another seed, other takes of the same documents.

max_duration.tooltip: The longest the take may run (the Song Sheet derives it from the score's length); YuE2 may end earlier.

takes.tooltip: How many takes: take seed, take seed + 1, ...; Check Vocals keeps the best. N takes cost N renders.

creativity.tooltip: From the brief: 0 steady, 50 the reference (the native defaults), 100 experimental (the default), 200 adventurous - the sampling of this block follows it. Here: the take's temperature, top-p and top-k (how freely YuE2 performs the score).

1.tooltip: The second take (seed + 1): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity high or highest, when the first take sang less than 96 % of the lyrics).

2.tooltip: The third take (seed + 2): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity highest, when neither take sang 96 % of the lyrics).

unet_name.tooltip: MiniMax Music 3's diffusion model in models/diffusion_models: the fp16 file (default) or minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot (2.5 GB, for 8-12 GB GPUs).

clip_name.tooltip: MiniMax Music 3's text encoder in models/text_encoders (int8 by default); the Song Sheet counts the 5,000-token prompt budget with it, exactly.

vae_name.tooltip: MiniMax Music 3's audio decoder in models/vae.

1.tooltip: The text encoder: the render and the token counts.

3.tooltip: The music model's rules and exact tokenizer, for Write Song and the Song Sheets.

caption.tooltip: The final caption (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

lyrics.tooltip: The final lyrics (Song Sheet): rendered exactly as given.

seed.tooltip: The take seed: another seed, another take of the same documents. It drives both the token and the audio sampling.

max_duration.tooltip: The longest the song may run (from the brief's length, at most 6:00); the model may end earlier.

switch.tooltip: Decode the audio in tiles: turn it on when decoding runs out of GPU memory (8-12 GB cards).

2.tooltip: The second take (seed + 1): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity high or highest, when the first take sang less than 96 % of the lyrics).

3.tooltip: The third take (seed + 2): rendered only when Best Take asks for it (lyrics fidelity highest, when neither take sang 96 % of the lyrics).

reference.tooltip: Optional: a recording whose tone the EQ matches (with a reference recipe in the block).

brief.tooltip: Optional: Song Brief or Cover Brief - the HQ presets on auto follow its genre.

hq_mastering.tooltip: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

stems.tooltip: Off (default): the song goes straight to Audio HQ. On: Separate Stems splits it into vocals, drums, bass and other, and the Stem Mixer inside this block mixes them back (gain, mute/solo, compression, reverb and delay, muted time ranges; a neutral mix returns the song unchanged). Needs the BS-RoFormer model (527 MB).

sample_rate.tooltip: keep, 44100 or 48000 Hz; converted before the limiter, so the true-peak ceiling holds.

0.tooltip: The mastered song (-14 LUFS, -1 dBTP true peak in the templates).

1.tooltip: The EQ's bands and the tone match.

2.tooltip: Loudness and true peak before and after.

3.tooltip: HQ 1: profile, settings and the side level before/after.

4.tooltip: HQ 2: profile, engine and the highs before/after.

5.tooltip: HQ 3 (bypassed in the templates): profile and the highs before/after.

6.tooltip: Stems on: per strip audible, gain, gain reduction, muted time - and the strips marked save, which Export Release writes next to the song ('<name>-stems'). Empty with stems off.

7.tooltip: Stems on: the stem names and how much the residual holds. Empty with stems off.

text.tooltip: The cover art prompt (the Song Sheet's artwork prompt).

noise_seed.tooltip: The cover seed: fixed, so new takes keep the cover; another seed, another cover.

size.tooltip: Width and height of the square cover in pixels.

0.tooltip: The cover image, for Export Release.

preset.tooltip: A prepared stage template: one choice sets PRE, POST and the crossover (500 Hz below PRE); template 3 suits MiniMax renders. *custom* uses the three fields below, which stay editable.

pre_hz.tooltip: Low-pass before the model (it shapes only what the model sees): 0 = the model's training condition, -1 = no PRE, else Hz (6000, 8000, 10000, 12000, 14000).

post_hz.tooltip: Linear-phase roll-off of the result: 0 = off, else Hz (16000, 19000, 21000 tame added air that sounds harsh).

crossover_hz.tooltip: Where the model takes over; 0: 500 Hz below the measured bandwidth.

audio.tooltip: The song to split, before mastering.

0.tooltip: The mixdown; a neutral mix returns the input unchanged.

1.tooltip: Per strip: audible, gain, gain reduction, muted time - and the strips marked save, which Export Release writes next to the song ('<name>-stems').

2.tooltip: Stem names and how much the residual holds.

seed.tooltip: The seed this node passes on. control after generate decides what happens to it after each run: fixed keeps it, increment and decrement step it, randomize draws a new one.

audio.tooltip: The audio file: one from ComfyUI's input folder, or upload one.
